tasks.subject: Task 0: Project scaffold + dependency install
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Runnable Python package skeleton with all geo deps importable.

**Files:** requirements.txt, geopdf/__init__.py, tests/__init__.py, tests/conftest.py, config/known_points.example.json, README.md

**Verify:** python -c "import pikepdf, fitz, pyproj, rasterio; from rasterio.control import GroundControlPoint; print('ok')" -> ok

```json:metadata
{"files": ["requirements.txt", "geopdf/__init__.py", "tests/__init__.py", "tests/conftest.py", "config/known_points.example.json", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "python -c \"import pikepdf, fitz, pyproj, rasterio; from rasterio.control import GroundControlPoint; print('ok')\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["pip install -r requirements.txt succeeds", "imports succeed", "conftest exposes 3 PDF paths fixture", "known_points.example.json documents format"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Decode one PDF's georeferencing (pdfgeo + crs)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Extract active viewport bounds + forensic GPTS scan with area/span/CRS.

**Files:** geopdf/crs.py, geopdf/pdfgeo.py, tests/test_pdfgeo.py

**Verify:** python -m pytest tests/test_pdfgeo.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["geopdf/crs.py", "geopdf/pdfgeo.py", "tests/test_pdfgeo.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_pdfgeo.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["decode_pdf returns viewport bounds+center+area+span+crs", "scan_all_gpts finds embedded boxes incl compressed", "ohv_single active viewport area < 1 km2", "ohv_dual scan finds >=7 boxes incl lat-span > 0.3"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Multi-file comparison report (report + CLI)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Decode all 3 PDFs into one comparison table (JSON + Markdown).

**Files:** geopdf/report.py, cli.py, tests/test_report.py

**Verify:** python -m pytest tests/test_report.py -v; then python -m cli report

```json:metadata
{"files": ["geopdf/report.py", "cli.py", "tests/test_report.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_report.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["build_report returns per-file viewport records", "render_markdown returns table string", "cli report writes output/bounds_report.json", "area<1 flagged SUSPECT (inset-scale)"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Diagnose vs known coords + decide fix path (diagnose + CLI)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Validate viewports vs known points, classify, choose Path A/B, write FINDINGS.md.

**Files:** geopdf/diagnose.py, cli.py, tests/test_diagnose.py

**Verify:** python -m pytest tests/test_diagnose.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["geopdf/diagnose.py", "cli.py", "tests/test_diagnose.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_diagnose.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["point_in_bounds correct", "classify_viewport returns main_map/inset/region/continental/off_region", "diagnose returns path_decision", "write_findings writes markdown with numbers", "logic tested with synthetic coords"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Collapse to single main-map viewport (fix_surgical + CLI)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rewrite the wrong active viewport's /GPTS to the correct extent, write *_corrected.pdf, prove via re-decode.

**Files:** geopdf/fix_surgical.py, cli.py, tests/test_fix_surgical.py

**Verify:** python -m pytest tests/test_fix_surgical.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["geopdf/fix_surgical.py", "cli.py", "tests/test_fix_surgical.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_fix_surgical.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["set_viewport_gpts writes new PDF with given GPTS", "corrected ohv_single active area 500-5000 km2", "original file untouched"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Render + georeference to GeoTIFF (render + raster)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rasterize corrected map to PNG and write EPSG:4326 GeoTIFF via shared GCP helper (also serves Path B).

**Files:** geopdf/render.py, geopdf/raster.py, cli.py, tests/test_raster.py

**Verify:** python -m pytest tests/test_raster.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["geopdf/render.py", "geopdf/raster.py", "cli.py", "tests/test_raster.py"], "verifyCommand": "python -m pytest tests/test_raster.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["render_page_png writes PNG returns dims", "corners_to_gcps maps GPTS corners to pixels (first=top-left)", "write_geotiff produces EPSG:4326 GeoTIFF bounds within 0.02 deg", "cli export writes viewer/winom-frazier_corrected.tif"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Local no-login Leaflet GeoTIFF viewer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Static browser page overlaying the corrected GeoTIFF on OSM with simulated + live GPS markers.

**Files:** viewer/index.html, viewer/app.js, viewer/style.css, README.md

**Verify:** Manual — python -m cli export then python -m http.server 8000; open http://localhost:8000/viewer/ and verify overlay lands on NE Oregon + pin placement.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["viewer/index.html", "viewer/app.js", "viewer/style.css", "README.md"], "verifyCommand": "python -m cli export then python -m http.server 8000 (open http://localhost:8000/viewer/)", "acceptanceCriteria": ["index.html loads Leaflet+georaster libs from CDN", "app.js overlays GeoTIFF and fits bounds", "lat/lon form drops/moves marker", "live GPS toggle via watchPosition", "README documents http.server + viewer URL"]}
```
